name: payment-reference
title: Payment Reference
description: Reference field that requires the invoice number in the expected format, checks each rail's length and character set (UPI, IMPS, NEFT, Faster Payments), moves a cut-off invoice number to the front, and previews the payee's statement line.

meta.stops: Transfer couldn't be matched to the invoice
meta.summary: Checks a bank transfer reference against each rail's length and character limits, so the invoice number reaches the payee intact.
catches: Missing, mistyped or different invoice number
Reference longer than the rail keeps, with the cut part struck through
Invoice number moved to the front when it would be cut off
Upper-casing on rails that do it
limits: Rail limits are sensible defaults, not guarantees; banks differ
Doesn't send the payment or reconcile it
Pattern for invoice numbers comes from your pattern prop
a11y: Visible label; input is described by a polite hint region
Rail picker is a labelled radiogroup

rules.note: Not verified this round: rail limits (UPI ~50 characters, NEFT remark boxes ~30, Faster Payments 18) are defaults from the code. Check your bank's own limits.
